summary: Part 3 (10:25 to 15:24) of the 2.1 Fulfillment App (KAM) video, covering Request products, Shipments (AWB, Quiqup pickup, packaging rules), SKUs available, Pending QC, the All inventory categories, Fulfilment live inventory (prices, inventory days), Inventory to return, Supplier inventory and Inventory exits. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened, and 5 frames that no claim cited (t00713, t00812, t00890, t00893, t00908) are now cited. Most screen facts are clearly visible. Several rules are spoken only, and some spoken numbers and words are garbled, so they are flagged in unclear or marked medium confidence rather than stated as firm facts.

Price times the number of units sent, per the trainer; 304 x 3 = 912 on screen.

A seller's sending of requested products, with tracking details, a Request Status and a Tracking company. The trainer says the shipment is sent to ReviveLab.

Products live in the fulfilment (171 at recording), grouped by supplier.

unclear.issue: The trainer asks for the 'buy box price', but the field on screen is labelled 'Buybox supplier' and shows 305, while Price shows 304. It is not clear whether 305 is a price or a supplier value.
'Warehouse received' is spoken as a request status but is not visible on screen. Only Requested and Cancelled appear on Request products.
Cancellation reasons ('missing item', 'rejected') and 'the lab' are spoken but not shown on screen. It is not confirmed that 'the lab' is ReviveLab (ReviveLab is named at 11:16).
'Picked up' is spoken as a shipment status but is not shown on screen. The shipment sections are Requested, AWB created, Under QC and Completed.
'It's free' follows the ReviveLab shipping sentence, but the speech does not say what is free (shipping, pickup or both), or for whom. Not stated as a fact.
'He must put everything in the random, safe box' and 'no need to use a {revive?} box' are garbled. It is unclear what box type is required, and whether a Revibe-branded box is needed.

'Several shipments contained several boxes contained in the same shipment' is garbled. It is unclear whether the seller or Revibe creates the airway bill for multi-box shipments, and the 30-laptop example is not confirmed.
'Once the {product?} are received so here pending qc no' is partly marked. Whether received products always go to Pending QC is not confirmed.
The 15 kg per box limit is spoken only. No screen shows it, and the number has not been checked against any other source.
The trainer says '33 days' then '36 days'. The screen shows 36 for the row. It is unclear whether 33 was a slip or a different figure, so it is not used as an ASR fix.
The charge, request and return buttons are mentioned, but no such buttons are visible in the frames, so their location cannot be confirmed.
'A price of drop two percent' is unclear. Nothing on screen matches a 2% rule, and the Price delta column (e.g. -5.88%) has no stated basis.

Trainer recommends connecting with the seller's password. This is a credential-sharing practice that is not described as an approved procedure on screen. Confirm whether it is allowed before treating it as a KAM procedure.

Inventory to return shows the Fulfillment filter as 12. The group headers DDH 5 and R3 Telco Electronics 5 do not match the 2 DDH rows and 3 R3 Telco rows shown; only 7 of the 12 rows are visible. The reason is not shown.

'If to drop price you don't need to consider it supplier inventory' is garbled. The rule for when an item is excluded from supplier inventory cannot be stated reliably. The Naif to drop price page is never opened.
In Supplier inventory the Out of stock filter badge shows 0, yet rows with Out of stock status are listed when that filter is selected (t00900.jpg, t00903.jpg).
TDRA is shown on screen and given as an example reason, but its meaning is never defined in the video.
The purpose of the SKUs available page and of its 'Quantities recommended' column is not explained by the trainer.
The meaning of the red, yellow and green dots next to Inventory days is not explained.
The second browser tab 'Seller starter pack - EN versi...' is open in every frame but never opened or mentioned. It is not verified that it holds the packaging or shipping rules.
